description: This file defines a FastAPI web application with dependency injection functions that extract query parameters and cookies, and an endpoint that demonstrates their usage.

methods.name: query_extractor(q: str | None = None)
methods.description: Extracts a query parameter 'q' from the request, returns None if not present.

methods.name: query_or_cookie_extractor( q: Annotated[str, Depends(query_extractor)], last_query: Annotated[str | None, Cookie()] = None, )
methods.description: Depends on 'query_extractor' and Cookie to extract either a query parameter or cookie value.

methods.name: read_query( query_or_default: Annotated[str, Depends(query_or_cookie_extractor)], )
methods.description: FastAPI endpoint that returns the value extracted either from query parameter or cookie.

ctags.name: query_or_cookie_extractor
ctags.signature: ( q: Annotated[str, Depends(query_extractor)], last_query: Annotated[str | None, Cookie()] = None, )
